title: Chefmake's Shine
description: The shine which you know and hate from melee is here!
body:
![TITLECARD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2bac425ac956feced42cc7a2b8a6eee166dac96.png)

This mod (as you guessed it) adds that ridiculously OP shine from super smash bros melee. It makes you invincible for the while also reflecting projectiles aswell. But in order to aquire it you'll need to do 1 thing, which is make the activator which gives the capablity like so:

![recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b6e5bc81a973e61b3bae568b8f879613ad3b364.png)

After activating by rightclicking you'll now be able to do it for aslong as you are not dead, since after death, the state is reset back so you'll need to craft it again.

Preforming the shine itself is quite simple; Just like in melee; sneak and press B (or in this carse it's R because B is already taken). Pair it up with the wavedash mod and you can waveshine you'll opponents to death. Careful tho, it's REALLY quite strong (around 4-5 hearts a hit) so you might wanna take a gamble next time you come across an enemy you're too afraid to come close to.
